name: A Kingdom Together
detailed_description:
🏰 About This Game

A Kingdom Together is a persistent multiplayer real-time strategy game where every building is player-placed, every role is player-driven, and kingdoms rise or fall based on how their players organize, cooperate, and lead.

Join one of four player-run kingdoms in a living, evolving world. Whether you become a farmer, trader, general, or regional governor, your contribution matters — both on the battlefield and behind the scenes. This is a game about collective strategy, political intrigue, and meaningful cooperation.

There are no idle timers or pay-to-win mechanics — just focused, fast-paced strategy that rewards smart planning and teamwork. Each game session lasts 1–2 weeks, then resets into a new world with a fresh server-wide storyline.

🏰 Player-Run Kingdoms

Join one of four player-run kingdoms and help shape its future. Every building is placed by real players, and each kingdom’s strength depends on cooperation, planning, and shared goals.

⚖️ Politics & Power

Elect your king or queen. Assign officers like Master of War or Master of Coin. Politics aren't just cosmetic — leadership roles grant powers and responsibilities that shape how your kingdom operates.

⚔️ Persistent Multiplayer Strategy

A living world shared by hundreds of players. Gather resources, build outposts, defend choke points, or lead the charge in coordinated assaults — everything happens in real-time.

🗺️ Territory Control & Defense

Claim and fortify regions on the world map to gain strategic bonuses. Watchtowers, castles, and siege warfare make every front line feel alive — and every inch of land hard-earned.

🌋 Dynamic Server-Wide Events

Every game tells a new story. Natural disasters, NPC invasions, and endgame crises (like rogue kingdoms or world bosses) push all players to adapt or unite.

📆 Fast, Focused Campaigns

Games last 1–2 weeks. No endless grind. No permanent pay-to-win. Just deep, meaningful multiplayer strategy that resets with a fresh world and new challenges.

🌍 A Living MMO-RTS World

Every building you see was placed by a player. Every war was started by players. Every outcome is shaped by real human strategy, not scripts.

Whether you enjoy commanding armies, managing resources, or navigating kingdom politics, A Kingdom Together invites you to take part in a shared world — one where your story truly matters.

Team up. Rise through the ranks. Build something that lasts — even if the world resets.

🚀 Join the Community

This game is being built in the open, with community feedback at its core.
Join the Discord to test the game, suggest ideas, and be part of shaping what A Kingdom Together becomes.

short_description: A persistent multiplayer RTS where players shape kingdoms through building, politics, and warfare. Join a kingdom, claim territory, elect leaders and defend your realm in fast-paced 1–2 week campaigns with dynamic events and player-driven strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 5770 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Game is online multiplayer only.
